items.source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
items.title: NDRRMA situation update — 9:00 a.m., 31 August 2026
items.summary: NDRRMA 9:00 a.m. update (31 Aug): 903 confirmed dead; 4,247 missing; 10,451 rescued so far. Fatalities reported across districts including Chitwan (272), Nawalparasi East (207), Nawalparasi West (151), Nuwakot (95), Gorkha (62), Dhading (55), Tanahun (37), Rasuwa (24). Missing includes large groups in Nuwakot and Rasuwa, hydropower workers, security/government personnel, and foreign nationals. 20,811 security personnel deployed; helicopter operations continuing. Unidentified remains at 21 district hospitals — confirm all figures on ndrrma.gov.np and Nepal Police portals.
items.citation: NDRRMA Nepal — 9:00 a.m. search/rescue/relief update (31 Aug)

items.source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
items.title: NDRRMA — Bhotekoshi water level rising again (31 Aug)
items.summary: On Sunday 31 August, NDRRMA warned that water levels in the flooded Bhotekoshi River had risen again and urged residents and rescue personnel in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Chitwan and nearby areas to take precaution. Agency said it would issue further updates after receiving additional information. Death toll and missing figures were also being updated on ndrrma.gov.np — always confirm on the original notice board.
items.citation: NDRRMA Nepal — public warning via official channels
